Description
Invest in a 1 oz Silver Round-Saint-Gaudens Double Eagle Inspired and take advantage of its investment-worthy features. The 1 oz silver Eagle rounds are an excellent way to preserve wealth and protect against inflation. The 1 oz Eagle silver coin contains 1 oz of 99.9% pure silver composition, making it a valuable asset in economic uncertainty.
But the 1 oz Silver Round-Saint-Gaudens Double Eagle Inspired is not just an investment opportunity; it’s also a beautiful piece to add to your collection. The iconic American Eagle design is intricate and visually stunning. The details on the coin showcase the Eagle in all its glory, making it a valuable addition to any coin collection. It represents a significant piece of American history, and owning one is a way to commemorate it.
Silver Towne Mint has worked with precious metals to service both the wholesale and retail markets. Today, as one of the largest private mints in North America, our bullion production supports the investment needs of Bullion Dealers and Investment Bankers around the world. Our commitment of combining the latest technology with Old World craftsmanship has earned us the reputation as a ‘best of both worlds’ mint. Silver Towne also specializes in custom minting of everything from fine art pieces to corporate challenge items.
Design of 1 oz Saint-Gaudens Inspired 1oz .999 Silver Round with Eagle Reverse
SilverTowne Trademark Augustus Saint-Gaudens Replica 1oz .999 Silver Medallion with Eagle Reverse – Single
Augustus Saint-Gaudens
(last name is also refered to as “St Gaudens”)
is widely known for designing the twenty-dollar gold coin minted from 1907-1933. This replica silver medallion is modeled after Augustus’ original striding-Liberty design which was is now currently used on modern American Gold Eagle Bullion coins.
The
obverse
design features a likeness of lady liberty carrying a torch and olive branch with sun rays in the background and stars lining the outer edge of the medallion. The
reverse
design has an eagle perched on a branch with the weight and purity designation of “ONE OUNCE .999 FINE SILVER” curved around the top of the piece along with the SilverTowne trademark logo beneath the eagle’s talons.
Main Highlights of 1 oz Saint-Gaudens Inspired 1oz .999 Silver Round with Eagle Reverse
Made of 1 Troy Ounce of .999 fine silver
Produced by the Silver Towne Mint
Replica of obverse of American double eagle $20 gold piece (designed by Augustus Saint-Gaudens)
Replica of reverse of American double eagle $20 gold piece (designed by Augustus Saint-Gaudens). The “T” in SilverTowne Mint is made using SilverTowne’s pickaxe mintmark logo
IRA-approved precious metal
